beats.desc: a hand drives a blue-handled screwdriver into the top mounting screw of the stainless doorknob and turns it counter-clockwise to unscrew it, while the other hand steadies the knob
the last screw backs out and the loosened doorknob with its round rose plate comes away from the door
beats.constraint: the screwdriver stays engaged with the screw and the hands stay at the doorknob.

subject: A man in a plain denim work shirt uses a blue-handled screwdriver to remove an exterior doorknob, working with both hands; the man
scene_keep: the white door, the stainless steel deadbolt above the stainless doorknob, and the bright sunny porch with a white railing, a wood fence and green foliage behind
